summary: AIM ImmunoTech filed an 8-K reporting two exchange agreements dated September 3-4, 2026 with Streeterville Capital, LLC, converting roughly $450,000 of a November 18, 2025 promissory note into 1,921,441 common shares at an average price of about $0.234 per share. The shares were issued under Section 3(a)(9) without commissions, following stockholder approval at a July 15, 2026 special meeting under NYSE American Sections 713(a)-(b). No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch dilution, note overhang, and any further exchange tranches impacting the debt balance.
